reviews.comment: Get ready to do literally all of the work yourself because Anne Nichols doesnt like teaching. Its a figure it out yourself course, and dont even think about wasting her time (her words, not mine) because youll be lucky to gain even a shred of knowledge about structural integration from her. She has taught me nothing at all.

reviews.comment: This class is a legendary horror story at Texas A&M University. An absolutely insane amount of homework. Nichols is not a mean person (necessarily), but her grading is very strict in that her grading criteria is very unfair (anything below a 50 on an assignment is a 0), her lectures do not make sense, and she refuses to answer questions clearly.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Worst grading! This subject is not that tough but she just like to make this tougher.

The other 614 students are complete liars!! most of the student's complaints are valid. This woman has THE worst class setup of any prof I've taken she cant get grades in on time and she doesn't help you when you ask and plus her so-called Homeworks are totally different than what she quizzes or tests you on. This class is actual dogwater!!!
Dr. Nichols is the bees knees. I would trust her. She has cats, and she talks about them a lot. Would I take this class again you say?... Does a cat enjoy hotdog water?

Gives a ridiculous amount of things due at around the same time. Incredibly hard to understand. Doesn't make the quizzes or exams any easier to study for. She doesn't pull the questions from anywhere, so even if you study from the note set or textbook, you can still fail. Doesn't grade on time at all. Worst professor I've ever had.

I would say stay away from this professor, but unfortunately, she's the only option for this class. She knows the material, but she just isn't a good teacher. Her video lectures which we have to watch before class are pointless and she spends over an hour explaining a problem but expects us to work four problems out in 30 min. for quizzes.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Its very unfortunate that she is the only prof for this class. Lectures were done before class and class was spent of practice problems. Tests included background info we never went over. TA grades most which is fine but when she graded i had no clue what it meant. answers emails but her answers arent helpful. Spent more time on this than studio.

reviews.comment: Prof Nichols created an environment of stress. Her lectures were not super helpful, her homework was often on a level beyond what we learned in lectures, and she is a pretty tough grader. While she knows her stuff, the feedback I received was often not super helpful or she directed me to another prof for help. She is accessible outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Anne Nichols certainly knows what she's talking about - but she simply cannot teach. If you're confused, it's your fault. She'll tell you to go watch YouTube videos when you are paying thousands for tuition. Her feedback on assignments is negligible, her lectures drone on and on, and her teaching is horrendous. Skip her... if you can, that is.

This class is fast-paced and there is a lot of info to learn. Be prepared to spend the majority of your time studying for this class. Prof gave points just for attending class which was nice. She moves through the material fast, but if you have trouble she is accessible outside class. Lots of math! Enjoyed her humor and passion for this material.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The WORST professor in ARCH. She quickly goes through information as if taking to herself and does not explain clearly. Her homework has nothing to do with the quizzes and therefore does not prepare you for them. You are expected to teach yourself everything. She needs to be replaced by someone who cares! She should not teach a required course!!!

The worst professor I've ever had. Homework is difficult and time consuming, having little to do with the quizzes. Her grading system is awful, she takes the lowest grade between homework and quizzes, and this becomes the base of your grade. Her lectures are fast and rather uninformative. Says she's there to "facilitate" learning, not teach.

Something has to be done about this horrid professor. She is the worst lecturer and least effective teacher i've ever had. Her lectures are confusing and her homework is intense. She doesn't care about you as a student, and was sometimes rude. Absolutely infuriating that she is the only option for this mandatory class. Maybe hire people that care?
